newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam woman to die for killing family of five.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam woman to die for killing family of five.

text.p: A Vietnamese woman was condemned to death for murdering three children and their parents by setting fire to their house as they slept, a Ho Chi Minh City People's Court official said on Monday.
The court found Phan Thi Ai, 27, guilty of murder and destroying property after hearing evidence that she had become entangled in a love affair with the man, and involved in a tiff with his wife.

The official confirmed a newspaper report that in February last year, Ai poured two litres of petrol through a window into a bedroom where the family was asleep and set it alight. All five people were burnt to death.
